row.title: A specification that names only the portable core lags the seed tick
row.body: Specs 01, 02, 03, 04, 05 and 08 described a seven-step tick and cited workers/core only, while seed/worker/src/tick.js ran 19 steps with tenant rows, a migration ledger, the in-tick doer, the manager register and metric probes. The specs now describe the seed tick as the reference, each new behaviour has a requirement ID appended at the end of its numbering, and the seed migration runner refuses a file that drops a table or column without a copy in the same atomic file (US-01-R13).
